entities.name: Pejačević Castle in Virovitica
entities.label: Text
entities.summary: Pejačević Manor is located in the Virovitica, which nowadays forms a part of the city centre of the city of Virovitica. It is one of several castles owned by the members of Pejačević noble family in the croatian region of Slavonia.
